from_notes: SVEEP – Systematic Voters' Education and Electoral Participation.
x: SVEEP (Systematic Voters' Education and Electoral Participation) is the ECI's flagship programme for voter awareness and participation. The ECI allots symbols under the Election Symbols Order, 1968, not by an express constitutional power; it cannot deregister a party for violating the RP Act (INC v Institute of Social Welfare, 2002); and seats per State are fixed by Parliament and the Delimitation Commission.
source: CARE APPSC Apr 2026 (src/current-affairs/care-appsc-2026-04.txt) p.37 (SVEEP aims to increase voter awareness and participation); Laxmikanth Indian Polity 8th ed. 02 p.149, p.372 (symbols under the Election Symbols (Reservation and Allotment) Order, 1968); PMF Lens 2026-09-01 p.18 (EC may deregister only for fraud etc.)

from_notes: Mission Investigation@75 Days | Bihar Police (from 1 Jan 2024) | Investigation and charge-sheet within 75 days of the FIR
x: Mission Investigation@75 Days was launched by Bihar Police from 1 January 2024: investigation, including the charge-sheet, must be finished within 75 days of the FIR (earlier the average was 261 days). Gujarat, Odisha and Uttar Pradesh are not linked to it.
source: ThePrint, 'Bihar Police to launch Mission Investigation@75 days from January 1, 2024' (theprint.in/india/bihar-police-to-launch-mission-investigation75-days-from-january-1-2024/1897996, via web search); app notes 6:30 (sub 9)

from_notes: The Gazette of India is printed and published by the Department of Publication / Directorate of Printing, under the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs.
x: The Gazette of India is published by the Department of Publication under the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (earlier Ministry of Urban Development) and printed by the Directorate of Printing; the e-Gazette is at egazette.gov.in.

from_notes: The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Bill, 2016 ... provides for a scheme of cashless treatment of road-accident victims during the 'golden hour'.
x: The Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Bill, 2016 (passed by the Lok Sabha on 10 April 2017) provided for a scheme of cashless treatment of road-accident victims during the 'golden hour' – the first hour after a traumatic injury. Silver, platinum and diamond hour are not terms used.
source: Praveen CA-360 Jan 2026 magazine (src/current-affairs/praveen-ca360-2026-01-magazine.txt) p.38 (golden hour = first one hour after a traumatic injury); Praveen CA-360 Feb 2026 magazine p.42 (Golden Hour Scheme – Motor Vehicles Act, 1988, Section 162)

from_notes: Employment News (Rozgar Samachar) is the weekly English job newspaper of the Publications Division, Ministry of Information and Broadcasting.
x: Employment News (Rozgar Samachar) is the weekly job newspaper published in English (and Hindi/Urdu) by the Publications Division, Ministry of Information and Broadcasting. Mint is a private business daily; 'Evening Post' and 'Weekly India' are not its publications.

from_notes: The 54th All India Conference of DGPs/IGPs was held at IISER, Pashan, Pune, on 6–8 December 2019.
x: The 54th All India Conference of DGsP/IGsP was held at IISER, Pune (Maharashtra) in December 2019, inaugurated by Home Minister Amit Shah on 6 December. Nashik, Bengaluru and Patna did not host it.

from_notes: Firecrackers | SC, Nov 2023 | Barium banned in firecrackers across India
x: In November 2023 the Supreme Court clarified that its order banning barium (barium salts/nitrate) in firecrackers applies across India, not only Delhi-NCR. Boron, chromium and strontium were not the subject of that ban.
source: PMF Environment 04 (src/environment/pmf-environment-04.txt) p.59 (SC directions prohibit crackers containing barium salts/barium nitrate); PMF Lens 2026-04-02 p.4 (SC has banned barium salts); app notes 6:31 (sub 5: Nov 2023 – barium banned in firecrackers across India)

from_notes: The Jammu and Kashmir Guest Control Order, in force from 1 April 2017, limited the number of guests at weddings and other functions.
x: The Jammu and Kashmir Guest Control Order (Food, Civil Supplies and Consumer Affairs dept.) applied from 1 April 2017 and capped guests – 500 at a daughter's wedding, 400 at a son's, 100 at engagements. Maharashtra, Rajasthan and Haryana issued no such order.
source: Business Standard (PTI, 21 Feb 2017) and Scroll.in, 'J&K government caps the number of guests' (via web search: rules from 1 April 2017)

from_notes: Dedicated on 25 February 2019 ... It has four concentric circles—Amar Chakra, Veerta Chakra, Tyag Chakra and Rakshak Chakra
x: Statement I is wrong: the National War Memorial was dedicated on 25 February 2019, not in 2021. II is right (the Amar Jawan Jyoti flame was merged with the memorial's flame in January 2022), III is right (it honours soldiers who died after Independence) and IV is right (four concentric circles – Amar, Veerta, Tyag, Rakshak Chakra), so the answer is II, III and IV only.
source: Praveen CA-360 Jun 2026 magazine (src/current-affairs/praveen-ca360-2026-06-magazine.txt) p.66 (dedicated 25 Feb 2019; honours personnel who died after Independence; four concentric circles); Amar Jawan Jyoti merger Jan 2022: general knowledge, not checked
